sloka: भ्रातुरादेशमाज्ञाय लक्ष्मणो वा परन्तपः ।स किमर्थं नरवरो न मां रक्षति राघवः ।। ५.६७.२२ ।।।।
transliteration: bhrāturādeśamājñāya lakṣmaṇo vā parantapaḥ ।sa kimarthaṁ naravaro na māṁ rakṣati rāghavaḥ ।। 5.67.22 ।।।।

translations.english: "— and unassailable even to the gods: for what reason do they overlook me? Surely some great misdeed of mine alone is the cause —
